text.title: Launch express delivery in Kazan? Six hats session, 12 June 2026
text.white: 3 pilot zones: 17% fewer late orders; no cost data for Kazan yet
text.red: Team is excited; support is worried about courier shortage
text.black: Couriers may run out at peak hours; margin could drop below 5%
text.yellow: Average order up 18% in pilot zones; loyal buyers get faster delivery
text.green: Start in 2 districts; add a surge fee at peak hours
text.blue: Question set by Anna; 6 hats in 45 minutes; facilitated by Ivan
text.order: White, red, black, yellow, green, blue: 6 minutes each; 9 participants
text.decision: Pilot in 2 districts from 1 July. Stop if margin is below 5% after 6 weeks. Owner: Anna
